exposure: Changes in the anatomical location of Bp points
cohort: 377 women at 6 weeks postpartum who visited the postpartum rehabilitation clinic between May 2022 and September 2022
finding: Vaginal wind is common among women at 6 weeks postpartum and is associated with functional constipation.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with increased odds of vaginal wind in women at 6 weeks postpartum.
